cohort: Participants were women from 529 families registered at the HHORAGES-France Association, where 74 women met specific criteria related to their DES treatment history and family pregnancies, allowing for observation of their children and grandchildren.
finding: The study found an increased preterm birth rate in DES and post-DES children, and a higher mean birthweight in DES full-term neonates compared to pre-DES neonates, with slight increases in preterm birth and low birth weight rates also observed in grandchildren of DES women.
birth_weight: Measured as a continuous variable and categorized as low birth weight
gest_age: Categorized as preterm birth and full-term (>=37 weeks of gestation)
